competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for systems consolidation using a fast-store to slow-store transfer model. Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.

topic_kernel.artifact: a fast-store to slow-store transfer model

competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a fast-store to slow-store transfer model.
competency.setting_constraint: Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include item-set hash, evaluator identity and aggregate verdict only.
Report retention after transfer and interference with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: losing source episodes during abstraction.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of systems consolidation.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report retention after transfer and interference against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for losing source episodes during abstraction; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
